verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions workflows are stored as YAML files in the repo, so they inherit full git history, review via Pull Requests/AGit workflow, and can be rolled back like any other versioned file (gitea-docs-2, gitea-docs-3, gitea-docs-1). However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated rollback/versioning UI or workflow specifically for automations (e.g., re-running a prior version, workflow run history diffing) - the capability is inferred from general git mechanics rather than demonstrated as an automation-specific feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of rollback/versioning UX for Actions workflows themselves, independent/hands-on confirmation that automation history and rollback work smoothly in practice.
